arms.B: same affordance policy with policy retrieval only; SIM_LUANTI_EPISODIC=policy

controls: fresh reset world and newborn checkpoint per arm
same genome identity, runtime seed, map seed, game configuration, spawn and stopping rule within each pair
prediction retrieval disabled in both arms
no action override, body-state reset, outcome label or task reward enters Rust
only position and velocity are returned to the common choice pose after an observation
consequences enter Rust only through ordinary VoxeLibre hunger interoception
non-choice primitives have no assigned bodily consequence

choice.forward_thrust: subtract four VoxeLibre hunger units, bounded at zero
choice.backward_thrust: add four VoxeLibre hunger units, bounded at twenty

fixture_validity.each_A_warmup_requires: at least 4 forward and 4 backward choices
fixture_validity.each_A_arm_requires: at least one observed negative fullness delta and one observed positive fullness delta
fixture_validity.invalid_fixture_rule: failure of exposure or opportunity invalidates the fixture and cannot count as a memory result

primary_success_rule.aggregate: during scored choices B has fewer resource-loss choices and more resource-return choices than A
primary_success_rule.paired: resource-return delta B-A is positive in at least 5 of 6 seeds and negative in none
primary_success_rule.mediation: B records a positive episode, retrieves it, produces positive score delta, changes an action, and the following observation records nonnegative fullness with at least one positive delayed fullness outcome in the arm

failure_rule: Any unmet primary success condition fails the episodic gate; these seeds are consumed after one paired run and thresholds are not changed from their outcomes.
